mem-base.description: PC's control: PA's r03 (BASELINE-FP8.md) on bs3. FP8 text checkpoint (G4POC_MODEL_DIR=.../gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-fp8ch/text), FP8 KV, Triton attention, decode graphs to bs 32, no prefill graph.

mem-l9-rope16k.description: L9: max_position_embeddings 262144 -> 16384 so the FP32 RoPE cos/sin caches (0.75 GiB) are sized to the served context; frequencies do not depend on it.

mem-l7-f096.description: L7: --mem-fraction-static 0.96 turns unused activation slack into KV pool.

mem-l7-f097.description: L7 probe beyond the safety rule: --mem-fraction-static 0.97.

mem-l10-c64.description: L10: --max-running-requests 64 shrinks req_to_token (2818 x 16384 int32) to 65 rows.

mem-l4-r0276.description: L4: --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.276 fit to the measured per-session mix (full 5,299; sliding 1,322 N + 2,544).

mem-stack1.description: Stack 1 of the flag levers: L9 (RoPE caches to 16384 positions) + L10 (max running 64) + L7 at the corrected safety margin (0.955) + ratio refit to the session mix (0.268).

mem-stack1b.description: stack1 on the L5 tree with the switch off: the control for L5's exactness and capacity (the switch-off path only adds a Req field).

mem-stack2.description: L5 on stack1: release the slid-out part of the tree-locked SWA window during decode, every 32 tokens; sliding/full ratio refit to the smaller per-session sliding hold.

mem-stack2-poison.description: mem-stack2 with the released SWA slots overwritten with NaN (debug): a read of a released slot corrupts the output. Exactness check only.

mem-stack3.description: L8 on stack2: the tied BF16 embedding/LM head replaced by one FP8 E4M3 table (per-row scales); decode graphs to bs 48 for batches above 32.

mem-q-ctl.description: Quality control for L8: stack2's numerics on the L8 tree with the switch off, at a lower static fraction and 1024-token prefill chunks so the guards' input-logprob requests fit (pool size does not change numerics).

mem-q-l8.description: Quality candidate for L8: mem-q-ctl with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FP8_VOCAB_TABLE on.

mem-stack3-xs.description: stack3 with the torch caching allocator on expandable segments, to remove the transient reserved-memory spikes seen under the real workload at 0.955.
